name: bigpixelrocket/laravel-mise
description: A Laravel package that provides a curated selection of packages and configurations

pall: composer pint && composer rect && composer pstan && composer pest
pint: bash -c 'FILES=$(composer changed-php-files 2>/dev/null | tail -n +2); if [ -n "$FILES" ]; then echo "$FILES" | xargs -r ./vendor/bin/pint --parallel; else echo "No PHP files changed, skipping Pint"; fi'
rect: bash -c 'FILES=$(composer changed-php-files 2>/dev/null | tail -n +2); if [ -n "$FILES" ]; then echo "$FILES" | xargs -r ./vendor/bin/rector process; else echo "No PHP files changed, skipping Rector"; fi'
pstan: bash -c 'FILES=$(composer changed-php-files:no-tests 2>/dev/null | tail -n +2); if [ -n "$FILES" ]; then echo "$FILES" | xargs -r ./vendor/bin/phpstan analyse --memory-limit=2G --; else echo "No non-test PHP files changed, skipping PHPStan"; fi'
